verses.en: Then answered Eliphaz the Temanite, and said,
verses.sm: Elifasa i le Timanu, ua faapea mai,

verses.en: Should a wise man utter vain knowledge, and fill his belly with the east wind?
verses.sm: E ono ea i le tagata poto ona tali O le lua o aoaiga a Elifasa atu ma le poto e le aoga, ma faatumuina lona manava i le matagi mai sasae?

verses.en: Should he reason with unprofitable talk? or with speeches wherewith he can do no good?
verses.sm: E aoai atu ea o ia i upu e le aoga, ma lauga e le tupu ai se lelei?

verses.en: Yea, thou castest off fear, and restrainest prayer before God.
verses.sm: A o oe, ua e faaleaogaina le matau, ma ua e faaleaogaina le tatalo i luma o le Atua.

verses.en: For thy mouth uttereth thine iniquity, and thou choosest the tongue of the crafty.
verses.sm: Auà ua faailoa e lou lava gutu lau amioletonu, ma ua e filifilia le laulaufaiva o e fai togafiti.

verses.en: Thine own mouth condemneth thee, and not I: yea, thine own lips testify against thee.
verses.sm: Ua faasalaina oe e lou lava gutu, a e le o aʻu; ua molimau foi ou laugutu ia te oe.

verses.en: Art thou the first man that was born? or wast thou made before the hills?
verses.sm: O oe ea le uluai tagata na fanau mai? pe na fanaua ea oe e muamua i mauga?

verses.en: Hast thou heard the secret of God? and dost thou restrain wisdom to thyself?
verses.sm: Ua e faalogologo ea i le pulega a le Atua? ua E taofia ea le poto mo oe lava?

verses.en: What knowest thou, that we know not? what understandest thou, which is not in us?
verses.sm: Sea se mea ua e iloa, e le iloa foi e i matou? se a se mea ua e poto ai, e le o ia te i matou foi?

verses.en: With us are both the grayheaded and very aged men, much elder than thy father.
verses.sm: O loo ia te i matou E ulusina atoa ma toeaina, e sili ona matutua i lou tama.

verses.en: Are the consolations of God small with thee? is there any secret thing with thee?
verses.sm: Ua faatauvaa ea ia te ce o faamafanafanaga mai le Atua, atoa ma upu mālie ua fai atu ia te oe?

verses.en: Why doth thine heart carry thee away? and what do thy eyes wink at,
verses.sm: Se a le mea ua ta‘ita‘ieseina ai oe e lou loto? pe se a foi le mea ua e mata faasiasia ai?

verses.en: That thou turnest thy spirit against God, and lettest such words go out of thy mouth?
verses.sm: Aua ua e liliu lou loto e tetee i le Atua, ma ua e faapunaia upu ai lou gutu.

verses.en: What is man, that he should be clean? and he which is born of a woman, that he should be righteous?
verses.sm: Se a ea le tagata, ia mama ai o ia, ma ia amiotonu lé ua fanau mai i le fafine?

verses.en: Behold, he putteth no trust in his saints; yea, the heavens are not clean in his sight.
verses.sm: Faauta, ua le faatuatua o ia i lona au paia; ua le mama foi le lagi i lana silafaga.

verses.en: How much more abominable and filthy is man, which drinketh iniquity like water?
verses.sm: E matuā sili ai ona inosia ma leaga le tagata, o lé inu i le amio leaga e pei o le vai.

verses.en: I will shew thee, hear me; and that which I have seen I will declare;
verses.sm: Ou te faailoa atu ia te oe, ia e faalogologo mai ia te au; ou te faamatalaina atu foi le mea ua ou vaala;

verses.en: Which wise men have told from their fathers, and have not hid it:
verses.sm: o le mea na faailoa mai e o popoto, sa iloa ai i o latou tama, mona ua latou le natia.

verses.en: Unto whom alone the earth was given, and no stranger passed among them.
verses.sm: Sa tuuina mai le lalolagi ia te i latou na o i latou lava; sa le ui ane foi se tagata ese ia te i latou.

verses.en: The wicked man travaileth with pain all his days, and the number of years is hidden to the oppressor.
verses.sm: Ua puapuagatia i ona aso uma le tagata amio leaga; ua natia foi i le tagata saua le faitau o ona tausaga.

verses.en: A dreadful sound is in his ears: in prosperity the destroyer shall come upon him.
verses.sm: Ua i ona taliga le leo e mataʻu ai; e oo atu ia te ia le na te faaumatia a o manuia o ja.

verses.en: He believeth not that he shall return out of darkness, and he is waited for of the sword.
verses.sm: Ua le manatu o ia e toe foi mai o ia ai le pouliuli; ua lamatia foi o ia e le pelu.

verses.en: He wandereth abroad for bread, saying, Where is it? he knoweth that the day of darkness is ready at his hand.
verses.sm: Ua fealualuai o ia e saili i mea e ‘ai, ua faapea ane, Po o ifea o i ai? ua iloa o ia ua latalata mai lava ia te ia le aso o le pouliuli.

verses.en: Trouble and anguish shall make him afraid; they shall prevail against him, as a king ready to the battle.
verses.sm: Ua faamatautia o ia c lc puapuaga ma le tiga; la te manumalo ia te ia, e pei o le tupu ua sauni i le taua.

verses.en: For he stretcheth out his hand against God, and strengtheneth himself against the Almighty.
verses.sm: Aua ua faaloaloa atu e ia lona lima i le Atua, ua faamalosia o ia e ia e tetee atu i Le e ona le malosi uma lava.

verses.en: He runneth upon him, even on his neck, upon the thick bosses of his bucklers:
verses.sm: E osofai o ia ia te ia ma le ua maaa, ma tua O ona talita ua putuputu.

verses.en: Because he covereth his face with his fatness, and maketh collops of fat on his flanks.
verses.sm: Aua e puputa lava ona mata, ta matuā puta lava o ia.

verses.en: And he dwelleth in desolate cities, and in houses which no man inhabiteth, which are ready to become heaps.
verses.sm: O le mea lea e nofo ai o ia i aai ua faaumatia, o fale foi ua le aina, e lata ona avea ma faupuegámaa.

verses.en: He shall not be rich, neither shall his substance continue, neither shall he prolong the perfection thereof upon the earth.
verses.sm: E le mauoa o ia, e le tumau foi lona oloa, e le faateleina lava e ia a latou mea i le nuu.

verses.en: He shall not depart out of darkness; the flame shall dry up his branches, and by the breath of his mouth shall he go away.
verses.sm: E le alu ese o ia i le pouliuli; e faamamagoina ona tatupu i le afi mumú, e avea foi o ia e le manava o lona fofoga.

verses.en: Let not him that is deceived trust in vanity: for vanity shall be his recompence.
verses.sm: O le ua faaseseina, aua le faatuatua o ia i le mea faatauvaa; aua e fai mona taui le mea faatauvaa.

verses.en: It shall be accomplished before his time, and his branch shall not be green.
verses.sm: Na te le aulia le atoatoa o ona aso, e le lauolaola foi ona la.

verses.en: He shall shake off his unripe grape as the vine, and shall cast off his flower as the olive.
verses.sm: Na te saaluuina.ona fua moto, e pei o le vine, ma lafoai ona fuga, e pei o le olive.

verses.en: For the congregation of hypocrites shall be desolate, and fire shall consume the tabernacles of bribery.
verses.sm: Aua e awavara le aiga o le tagata faalematau; e susunuina foi i le afi fale ie o e tali taw.

verses.en: They conceive mischief, and bring forth vanity, and their belly prepareth deceit.
verses.sm: Ua totò i latou i amio leaga, ua fananau foi e i latou le agasala, ua sauniuni foi e o latou loto mea faa'ole“ole.
